p: I photographed these 2 on an old ash tray thingy which is good for these sorts of marine shots. A Striped Polyclad Worm, Eurylepta californica, and a Cockerell's Dorid, Limacia cockerelli. I've since learned that handling Nudibranchs in any capacity can potentially harm them, more so than most creatures at least, so I probably wont get any more of these sea-creature-in-black shots. Although I'm not sure if the same logic applies to Flatworms. I guess I could also give it a shot with crabs, but they move around too much.
